title: Uludağ Ascent
slogan: From Bursa up the Mysian Olympus: two thousand metres gained on a paved road, with the plain behind you the whole way.

waypoints.name: Bursa
waypoints.advice: Bursa is where the day begins. Next is Sarıalan, 22 km on and climbing 1530 m.

waypoints.name: Sarıalan
waypoints.advice: Sarıalan comes up 22 km in. The road climbs 1530 m over the 22 km before it, hard. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Uludağ, 22 km on and climbing 270 m.

waypoints.name: Uludağ
waypoints.advice: 1900 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 270 m over the 22 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Çekirge, 22 km on and mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Uludağ Ascent
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 10.6%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Uludağ Ascent
scenicChapters.narrative: 1900 m come off over 36 km at around 7.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
